name: Fried crickets
summary: Crickets fried and finished with lime, chili, and minced lemongrass, a plate found at many Kon Tum restaurants. They smell strongly of the fryer and taste nutty and rich.
origin: One of Kon Tum’s country specialties, made with dế than, dế cơm, or dế lửa.
taste: A strong fried smell, then a nutty, rich bite.
howToEat: The crickets are washed, drained, and fried, then tossed with lime, chili, and minced lemongrass.
seoDescription: Crickets fried with lime, chili, and lemongrass, nutty and rich, at restaurants in Kon Tum.
